commitThreshold: three distinct hinges selected, then one verdict committed
memoryRule: three selected hinges stay exact while a verdict changes three remote hinges as turn, pin, and register roles; four routes persist
interactionRule: pointer or touch selects three distinct hinges; Enter, Space, or the verdict control commits; ArrowRight selects the deterministic route; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: one solid aperture mass, one compound contour, and split angular folds -> nine separate paired hinge paths in open ground
compositionRupture: heavy body, singular void, and two-margin field -> sparse diagonal register with a broken channel and unequal joints
encounterRupture: choose one absence, turn a bounded sweep, and wait for a delayed answer -> select a three-node route, then commit a collective verdict
temporalRupture: remote aperture response, winding memory, and refusal field -> discrete route memory that produces three non-selected roles and compounds
mediumRupture: even-odd bodies, one contour, and angular fold paths -> nine produced paired inline SVG paths with actual blade geometry
changedRule: A route of three distinct hinges remains geometrically exact. Its committed verdict is produced at three remote hinges: one turns, one pins, and one slips its register.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is a sparse register of nine unequal paired hinges around an open diagonal channel. A valid verdict changes actual remote path length, gap, lean, angle, and position while the selected route stays exact; four verdicts persist.
falsifier: Delete if the blind field reads as a node diagram, fold diagram, or decorative mark set; if route selection changes geometry; if a selected hinge answers itself; if remote roles are cosmetic; if later verdicts reset; or if exact lifting fails.
deletionCondition: Delete v041 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish the hinge register from v038-v040 or if a three-node route does not produce materially remote SVG consequences.
